title: Prompt-Return Reduction on Residential Natural Gas Supply Re-Contracts
content:
**Rule.** For a Residential Natural Gas Supply agreement that has rolled over and is re-contracted, the prompt-return reduction depends on the calendar days from the rollover date recorded as the plan change date to the election date: 0.0100 per therm when those days are no more than 10, 0.0050 per therm when they are more than 10 and no more than 20, and no reduction when they are more than 20. The reduction lowers the re-contract rate by that amount per therm.

The rollover date is the plan change date shown on the agreement record after rollover; the election date is the day the customer re-contracts.

| Calendar days from the plan change date to the election date | Prompt-return reduction per therm |
|---|---|
| 0 to 10 | 0.0100 |
| 11 to 20 | 0.0050 |
| 21 or more | none |

### Both sides of each threshold (hypothetical plan change date 1 April)

| Election date | Days | Reduction |
|---|---|---|
| 11 April | 10 | 0.0100 |
| 12 April | 11 | 0.0050 |
| 21 April | 20 | 0.0050 |
| 22 April | 21 | none |
